name: Ren'ai Joutou! Ikemen Gakuen
original_name: 恋愛上等！イケメン学園
source: After having to change schools, the protagonist finds herself in a new boarding high school where... she's the only girl?! In a school that depends in man-to-man relationships, how will a girl survive?
translation: After having to change schools, the protagonist finds herself in a new boarding high school where... she's the only girl?! In a school that depends in man-to-man relationships, how will a girl survive?
